realismRules: All randomness is deterministic from the blueprint seed.
Parties, items, accounts, tax codes, dimensions, and transaction dates must be compatible.
Credits, refunds, deposits, payments, inventory movement, and journals have explainable source lifecycles.
Closed periods are not silently rewritten.
Intentional exceptions are tagged and remain distinguishable from drift.
